answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s “Encounters with the Shadow,” Awake Academy’s “Embracing the Shadow” with Charlie Morley, and ManTalks’ “Shadow Course.”** These appear to be the most substantial and practice-oriented offerings among the listed courses.[2][6][17][18]

A practical way to choose is by your goal:

- **Most Jungian / psychologically grounded:** **Encounters with the Shadow** on Jung Platform is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[6]
- **Most explicitly spiritual / transformative:** **Embracing the Shadow** with Charlie Morley is presented as a transformative course focused on shadow integration and personal change.[18]
- **Most guided and structured:** **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** from ManTalks is an immersive 8-week guided process for facing and integrating the shadow.[17]
- **Best for a broad, beginner-friendly online introduction:** Udemy’s **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** and **Shadow Work Essentials** both focus on uncovering and healing repressed parts of the psyche.[3][11]
- **Best for workbook-style practice:** **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** emphasizes lessons, exercises, diagrams, meditations, prayers, and practices, which may suit someone wanting a more devotional or spiritual format.[10]

Here’s a simple comparison:

| Course | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** | Jungian depth | In-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work.[6] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** | Spiritual transformation | Marketed as transformative and relationship-focused.[18] |
| **Shadow Course** | Guided practice | 8-week immersive process.[17] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | Beginners | Focuses on healing, gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Structured self-study | Includes exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices.[10] |

If you want the **best overall match for shadow work plus spiritual practice**, I’d start with **Encounters with the Shadow** for depth and **Shadow Course** or **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** for hands-on practice.[6][10][17]

If you want, I can also narrow these down by **budget, beginner level, or whether you prefer Jungian psychology, meditation-based practice, or more explicitly spiritual teaching**.
